correctness.rationale: PASS. Smooth complete intersection of quadrics follows because distinct indices 0..4 modulo p>=7 preclude gradient dependence on a point of S. Anticanonical embedding makes biregular automorphisms projective, and singular pencil vertices force monomial matrices. A PGL2 permutation on T={0,1,2,3,4} lifts over the algebraic closure, with kernel (C2)^4. Independent exact rational nullspace interpolation of all 120 permutations found zero residual only for identity/reversal and exceptional residual-prime support {2,3,5,7,11,13}. Modular admissibility gives stabilizer sizes 6,10,6 at p=7,11,13 and 2 otherwise. Checking every admissible modular denominator Legendre character found only identity/reversal have uniform character, so rational automorphism size 32 for every p>=7. Every Fp* element becomes a square in Fp²; geometric lifts all descend there. Generic group (C2)^4⋊C2 and exceptional S3/D5 follow. The integer residual enumeration, not testing finitely many p, is what proves the all-prime assertion.
